plugin.name: Sync
plugin.description: Sync the desktop app with one or more servers, and manage other Termix servers as remote sites from a master.

sites.title: Manage remote sites
sites.description: Add, edit and remove remote Termix sites and open sessions on their hosts.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.removeDescription: {{name}} and its copy of the data on this device will be deleted. The server keeps its data.
accounts.notLinked: Not linked to a server yet
accounts.signedInHere: Also signed in on this browser

sites.title: Sites
sites.addHelp: Make an API key on the other Termix server and paste it here. This server can then list its hosts and open sessions on them. The key's user there decides what you can see.
sites.name: Name
sites.apiKeyHint: Made on the other server, in its API key settings.
sites.failed: The site was added but could not be reached
sites.removeDescription: {{name}} is forgotten here. The API key stays valid on that server until you delete it there.
sites.empty: Add another Termix server and its SSH hosts show up in your host list.

terminal.title: Remote session
terminal.unavailable: Sessions are not available right now

sites.intro: The SSH hosts of each site appear in your host list in a folder named after the site. They are read only here, change them on the site. Opening one starts the session through the site.
sites.nameHint: Also the name of the folder its hosts are in.
sites.apiKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved key.
sites.shareHint: Roles that can see and open them. Only you can by default.
sites.noRoles: There are no roles to pick.

sync.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.
sync.unlinkedBody: Termix works on its own on this device. Link it to your Termix server to keep everything in step.
sync.unlinkedPointHosts: Your hosts, credentials, snippets and settings follow you to every device.
sync.unlinkedPointOffline: Everything still works when the server cannot be reached, and catches up later.
sync.unlinkedPointAccount: You sign in with your server account, and hosts people shared with you show up here too.
sync.unlinked: This device is no longer linked
sync.unlinkDescription: It stops syncing and signs out of the server. Hosts shared with you by others are removed from this device either way.
sync.unlinkKeepBody: Your hosts, credentials and settings stay on this device and keep working on their own.
sync.unlinkRemoveBody: Everything that came from the server is removed from this device. Hosts kept on this device only stay.
sync.conflictsDescription: These were changed here and on the server at the same time. The server version is in use. Keep yours to send it to the server instead.
sync.errorsDescription: The server did not accept these changes. They stay on this device.
sync.errorPermission: Your account on the server is not allowed to make this change.
sync.whatSyncsDescription: Turn off anything you want to keep on this device only.
sync.notOnServer: The server does not have this
sync.localOnlyHint: You can also keep single hosts or folders on this device from their settings.
sync.originDescription: Connect to hosts from this device, or through the server. You can change this per host.

proxy.title: Reverse proxy
proxy.description: Only needed when something like Cloudflare Access or a login page sits in front of your server.
proxy.headersHint: Sent with every request to the server, for example a Cloudflare Access service token.
proxy.basicAuthHint: For a proxy that asks for a username and password before Termix.
proxy.allowInvalidCertificateHint: Only for your own server, when its certificate is not from a known authority.

problems.invalidUrl: That does not look like a web address.
problems.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check the address and that the server is running.
problems.tlsUntrusted: The server certificate is not trusted. If this is your own server with a self-signed certificate, turn on the option below.
problems.basicAuthRequired: Something in front of the server asks for a username and password. Enter them below.
problems.proxyLogin: A login page or proxy answered instead of Termix. Add the headers it needs below, or check the address.
problems.notTermix: There is no Termix server at that address. If it runs under a path, include it, like https://example.com/termix.
problems.versionMismatch: That server runs an older Termix. Update it to 2.9 or newer to link.
problems.differentAccount: You signed in to a different account. Sign in to the account this device is linked to, or unlink first.

wizard.title: Link to a Termix server
wizard.serverDescription: Enter the address you use to open Termix in your browser.
wizard.chooseDescription: This device already has data. What should happen to it?
wizard.mergeBody_one: The item on this device is added to your account. Items your account already has stay as they are on the server.
wizard.mergeBody_other: The {{count}} items on this device are added to your account. Items your account already has stay as they are on the server.
wizard.replaceBody_one: The item on this device is removed, and this device takes everything from your account. Hosts kept on this device only stay.
wizard.replaceBody_other: The {{count}} items on this device are removed, and this device takes everything from your account. Hosts kept on this device only stay.
wizard.linking: Linking and running the first sync...
wizard.linked: Linked. Your data is syncing now.
wizard.signedInAgain: Signed in. Sync is running again.

onboarding.desktopTitle: How do you want to use Termix?
onboarding.desktopBody: You can change this any time from Sync in the sidebar.
onboarding.desktopLocalBody: Everything is stored here. Nothing to set up.
onboarding.desktopLinkBody: Sign in to your server to use the same hosts and settings on every device.

errors.authTokenMissing: The server did not return a new authentication token. Please sign in again.
